source_text: Καὶ πρῶτον μὲν τὰ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄχλου πανδημεὶ σωρηδὸν ἐπιφερόμενα γενναίως ὑπέμενον, ἐπιβοήσεις καὶ πληγὰς καὶ συρμοὺς καὶ διαρπαγὰς καὶ λίθων βολὰς καὶ συγκλείσεις καὶ πάνθ᾽ ὅσα ἠγριωμένῳ πλήθει ὡς πρὸς ἐχθροὺς καὶ πολεμίους φιλεῖ γίνεσθαι, καὶ δὴ ἀναχθέντες εἰς τὴν ἀγορὰν ὑπό τε τοῦ χιλιάρχου καὶ τῶν προεστηκότων τῆς πόλεως ἐξουσιῶν ἐπὶ παντὸς τοῦ πλήθους ἀνακριθέντες καὶ ὁμολογήσαντες, συνεκλείσθησαν εἰς τὴν εἱρκτὴν ἕως τῆς τοῦ ἡγεμόνος παρουσίας.
orientation: The writers describe what the Christians first suffered from the crowd and city officials before the governor arrived.
pass_a_gloss: And first on the one hand the things brought upon them from the crowd all together in a heap they endured nobly, shoutings and blows and draggings and tearings apart and throwings of stones and lockings up and all things as many as are accustomed to happen from an enraged multitude toward enemies and hostile opponents, and indeed having been led up into the marketplace by both the chiliarch and the authorities set over the city, having been examined before the whole multitude and having made profession of faith, they were locked up together into the prison until the arrival of the governor.

lemmas.gloss: all together as a whole people
in a heap, in a mass

choices.why: keeps both adverbs literal and separate, crowd action piled together
brief fixes ὁμολογία as profession of faith, public I am a Christian, not guilt
brief fixes ἡγεμών as Roman provincial governor
literal Roman officer title, not generalized

pass_b_english: First they bravely endured everything the crowd heaped upon them all together in a heap. There were shouts and blows and dragging and tearing and volleys of stones and confinement, and every outrage an enraged multitude inflicts upon enemies in war. Then the chiliarch and the leading authorities of the city brought them up to the marketplace. They were questioned before the whole crowd, and once they had made their profession of faith, they were shut together in prison until the governor arrived.
